prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 2024年重点信息化项目执行情况汇总表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 215px
  col 2: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "预算（万元）" · longest unbreakable word 60px · one-line width 92px
  col 4: header "进度" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 373px
  col 5: header "风险说明" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 1830px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"A one-page management summary of 2024 IT project execution: each row is a project, and readers check owner, budget, progress narrative and risk note together — the table is read row-by-row for status, and column-by-column only for budget or risk comparisons.","reading":"The eye enters at the project name (the row's identity), jumps right to 预算 for the money figure, then reads 进度 and 风险说明 as two prose fields that carry the actual status story. 负责人 is a small lookup field consulted occasionally, so it should be narrow but still show the full name on one line. Because the two prose columns are long, rows are already multi-line tall, so wrapping there costs nothing; the project name and the budget figure are what must stay legible at a glance.","groups":["col 1 项目 — row identity, must anchor each row","col 2 负责人 — short lookup attribute of the row, sits next to the project name","col 3 预算（万元） — numeric comparison column, must stay whole and right-aligned in feel","col 4 进度 and col 5 风险说明 — twin prose fields, both naturally wrap, should be sized as a pair rather than independently"],"keep_intact":["预算（万元） header (60px unbreakable) and all budget figures such as 1,280.00 — never split or wrapped","负责人 header and the 3-character names on one line","项目 names: at minimum no mid-word break of identifiers like “一网通办”, “信创迁移”; ideally whole on one or two lines","进度/风险说明: keep phrases like “UAT 测试计划”, “3 个试点处室迁移”, “60%” unbroken"],"may_wrap":["项目 names (2 lines acceptable)","进度 sentences (already multi-line in every row)","风险说明 paragraphs (very long, will always wrap to many lines — the main absorber of width)"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [210, 68, 100, 175, 166] · table 720×1544px · row heights [60, 339, 269, 269, 269, 339] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [160, 68, 100, 195, 196] · table 720×1265px · row heights [60, 269, 222, 222, 222, 269] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [140, 68, 96, 155, 260] · table 720×963px · row heights [60, 199, 153, 176, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

Meanwhile 项目/预算/进度 cells are half-empty vertical space, so the reader's eye runs down a narrow column of text next to three near-blank blocks. The 预算（万元） header still breaks into two lines.","cause":"166px for 风险说明 (145px of text) is far too little for the column that is 1830px of content — it is the sole height driver. 210px on 项目 buys nothing beyond one-line names, and 100px on 预算 is under the 113px needed for the 60px header to stay whole."},{"design":"r0B","good":"Much better balance: the two prose columns (195/196) are treated as the pair they are, and height drops to 1265px. Project column at 160px keeps rows legible as units and 负责人 stays a clean one-line lookup.","problems":"Still tall because 风险说明 only gets 175px of text and runs 11 lines. 进度 is given nearly the same width as 风险说明 even though its content is ~5× shorter, so ~40px of width is wasted there while the tallest column is starved. 项目 names break mid-phrase (“一网通办”改造 splits across the line). 预算（万元） header wraps again.","cause":"Equal widths for unequal content (195 vs 196) plus a 100px budget column. The height is set by 风险说明, so any pixel taken from 进度 and given to 风险说明 shortens every row."},{"design":"r0C","good":"By far the best proportion and rhythm: 963px, rows 153–199px, risk at 260px reads as a proper paragraph, and the whole table fits a page with the status story visible at a glance.","problems":"项目 at 140px is too cramped — identifiers break mid-word (“协同办|公平台信创迁移”, “一网通|办”改造), which damages the row's identity. 预算 at 96px is below the threshold, so “预算（万/元）” splits and the money figure looks squeezed against its neighbours. 进度 at 155px produces ragged 3–4 line blocks that visually compete with the risk text.","cause":"96 < 113px needed for the 预算 header; 140px is under the ~165px where project names break on a sensible boundary rather than mid-phrase."}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-budget-whole","widths":[165,68,113,150,223],"change":"Take r0B as the base and rebalance: give 预算 113px so “预算（万元）” stays on one line and the figure is unmistakably a money column; take that 13px plus the slack from 进度 (195→150, it only needs ~3 lines) and hand ~27px to 风险说明 (196→223), the only column driving row height. 项目 at 165px keeps names to two clean lines instead of mid-phrase breaks."},{"name":"risk-first","widths":[150,68,113,140,248],"change":"Push r0C's best instinct further: 风险说明 is 1830px of content and sets every row's height, so give it 248px (≈8 lines instead of 14 in r0A). 项目 150px is the minimum where names still break at a phrase boundary, 进度 140px is enough for 3 short lines, and 预算 stays at 113px so its header never splits."},{"name":"project-anchored","widths":[185,68,113,145,208],"change":"Alternative emphasis: treat 项目 as the anchor the eye enters on and give it 185px so all names land on one or two lines with no awkward break, at the cost of 15px from 风险说明 (208px, still ~9 lines). 进度 145px keeps its 3-line shape and 预算 113px keeps the header whole."}]}
